Lexaru ist ein junges GovTech-/LegalTech-Startup, das Verwaltungsprozesse mit modernen Anwendungen digitalisiert. Unsere Produkte unterstützen Sachbearbeiter:innen im Verwaltungsalltag und tragen zu effizienter Verwaltung und besseren Services für Bürger:innen bei.

Unterstützt werden wir unter anderem durch das Legal Tech Colab der TU München und die Plattform AI Nation.

Du arbeitest remote-first mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direktem Austausch mit den Gründern. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und gestaltest gesellschaftlich relevante Produkte für die öffentliche Verwaltung mit.
Wir unterstützen deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch praktische Erfahrung, regelmäßiges Feedback und eigene Projekte.
Deine Entwicklung gestalten wir gemeinsam mit dir – durch technische Spezialisierung, wachsende Verantwortung oder Führungsaufgaben.

Produkt & Entwicklung
Du entwickelst Full-Stack Features und vollwertige interne Tools von der Idee über Architektur, Implementierung und Testing bis zum Rollout. AI / LLM

Dabei nutzt du Prompt- und Context Engineering, RAG, Tool Calling und strukturierte Modellausgaben. Du triffst Architektur- und Modellentscheidungen, entwickelst geeignete Evaluierungen und stellst durch Guardrails, Logging und Monitoring einen zuverlässigen Betrieb sicher. Du wirkst an der Architektur unserer Plattform (Services, Datenmodell, Security) mit, verantwortest gemeinsam mit uns Deployment, CI/CD und Monitoring und achtest auf Security, Performance, Kosten und Stabilität im produktiven Betrieb.
Zusammenarbeit & Produktdenken
Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern und Kunden zusammen, übersetzt Nutzerbedürfnisse in technische Lösungen und klare User Stories und bringst eigene Ideen ein. Du wirkst an der Priorisierung mit und triffst pragmatische technische Entscheidungen.

Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in professioneller Full-Stack Produktentwicklung. Als Richtwert gelten vier oder mehr Jahre. Auch mit weniger Erfahrung freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, wenn du uns von deiner Expertise überzeugst.

Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in modernen Backend-Technologien wie Node.js oder Django.

Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb LLM-basierter Anwendungen, einschließlich RAG, Tool Calling und strukturierter Modellausgaben. Du kannst KI-Workflows eigenständig entwerfen, integrieren und ihre Qualität durch systematische Evaluation und Fehleranalyse weiterentwickeln.

Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig, kommunizierst klar und bringst Aufgaben zu Ende. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen.

title: Full Stack Developer (Onboarding & Enablement)
description:
We turn every customer interaction into an opportunity. We connect conversations, customer data and payments with AI Agents so that companies can deliver personal customer journeys at scale: both online and in person.

“The entire customer journey. One platform”

What we value
Every CM.com colleague, connects to our 4 shared values :

Drive and Lead
You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward.

Grow and Learn
The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. You like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others.

Together and Care
We work together and we believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. You value the social side of work, you show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being.

Speed and Change
By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. You are comfortable with change and you love working in a high paced environment.

The Role
As a Full Stack Developer in the Onboarding & Enablement team, you'll own the front door of CM.com connectivity: the self service experience where customers sign up and start messaging in minutes, without a sales call or a single email. It is one of the most important topics at CM.com today, and your team is the conductor behind it.
In today's tech market, speed wins. Customers choose the provider they can start with right now, and they value ease over a long list of requirements. Think of how quickly you can take out a phone subscription: that is the experience we want to offer. Our customers are people, but increasingly also AI agents, and neither wants to wait for a callback.
Behind that one simple interface sits a complex platform. Every channel works differently. For example: WhatsApp runs via Meta, RCS via Google and Orange, and more channels and suppliers are joining. Customers should never notice any of that. The complexity is ours, not theirs.

You will
Build the self service onboarding experience that takes customers from sign up to their first message in minutes

Turn every customer request into the right configuration across our own systems and external suppliers, fully automated

Make it easy to plug in new channels and supplier partnerships, so the platform grows without adding complexity for the customer

Drive automation across the full customer journey, for people and AI agents alike

Own your work from idea to production, including how it runs on our infrastructure

Use AI tools actively to improve your own work: experiment, automate, and share what works with your team

Medior to senior full stack developer with hands on experience in both front end and back end

Strong in Angular on the front end, and in C# and .NET on the back end

Solid knowledge of relational databases, such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL

Fluent in English and Dutch

Nice to have: experience with DevOps or system engineering, as the team also manages its own infrastructure

Genuinely curious about AI: you experiment with tools like ChatGPT or Copilot and you're open to working differently as they improve

Believe you’d be a great fit for this role, even if you don’t tick every box? Reach out to our Recruitment team! We’d be happy to connect and see if we can make it work together.

What we offer
As a CM.com club member, you’ll have the following benefits:
Onboarding : Join our unique 3-days Global Onboarding program in our Headquarters in Breda, a deep dive into the culture of CM.com.

Healthy food: Daily healthy lunches and snacks to keep you energized.

Effortless commute: The Shuttle mobility card, commuting allowance and Lease-a-bike options get you where you need to be. We have CM company cars that you can use for client visits as well.

Invest in your future : A solid pension plan.

Time off: Recharge with 25 vacation days, plus the option to purchase 10 additional days.

Own your success: Become a shareholder with our Employee Share Purchase Program.

Your Development : We support your growth and development through initiatives like the CM Academy, Udemy courses, exclusive meetups with thought leaders, the Young Professional Program, and our own CM Business Adventure (CMBA), ensuring you’re always learning and evolving

Vitality : Our Vitality Team organizes a year-round vitality program to support a healthy body and mind for all colleagues. Think of stress prevention workshops, ergonomist visit, weekly bootcamps, yoga sessions and our CM sports day.

Together at CM.com : Weekly drinks, board game nights, karaoke throwdowns, yearly ski trip, and more! We have something for everyone.

Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and drive us forward. We welcome everyone, regardless of age, background, or beliefs.

Before you apply
We work on-site, move fast, and expect you to bring your own thinking. Priorities shift, AI is actively changing how we work and we embrace that reality. If that sounds like a great environment to you, we'd love to hear from you.

Note: For this position, we can only consider candidates who already hold a permanent work and residence permit for the Netherlands.

Senior Software-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React – Berlin
Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.
Auf einen Blick
Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD

Vertrag: unbefristet, Vollzeit

Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote

Standort: Berlin-Zehlendorf, direkt am S-Bahnhof Zehlendorf (S1)

Produkt: Konsentas, ein Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement für Behörden

Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle
Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.
Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.
Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen

Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen

Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln

Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen

Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden

Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)

Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID

Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework

Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1

Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.

Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen bei uns genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

-
Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.
Dein Team
Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Daniel (Developer Lead), Nico (Geschäftsführer & Projektmanager), der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Daniel und Nico übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Ein sinnstiftendes Produkt, das täglich in Bürgerämtern genutzt wird, in einem krisensicheren Markt

Echter Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen und eine Modernisierung mit klarem Ziel

30 Urlaubstage

title: Staff Engineer, Full Stack (Trust, Safety & Risk)
description:
Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Phantom partners with many of the most trusted and influential names in finance like Hyperliquid, Stripe, Kalshi and Visa, to make the most popular and innovative financial products accessible to everyone.

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.


Responsibilities

As a Trust, Risk & Safety Engineer at Phantom, you’ll build the systems that safeguard our users, products, and platform. Working across the stack, you’ll detect and prevent abuse, assess emerging risks, reduce financial loss, and equip internal teams with the tools and intelligence needed to respond quickly and effectively. The ideal candidate brings high agency, a strong sense of ownership, exceptional technical judgment and product taste, a relentless work ethic, and the emotional intelligence to navigate complex, high-stakes situations.



Fraud prevention: Build real-time risk controls and decisioning systems for products such as ACH, debit cards, onramps, off-ramps, and other money movement experiences.




Scam and abuse detection: Develop signals, models, and product interventions that identify malicious wallets, transactions, applications, and user behavior.




Identity and compliance infrastructure: Build scalable KYC, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, case management, and audit systems.




Data and intelligence: Create pipelines and tools that combine on-chain activity, product data, and third-party signals into actionable risk insights.




Product safety: Partner with product and engineering teams to design safeguards into new features from the beginning without compromising the user experience.




Operational tooling: Build internal tools that help Risk, Compliance, Support, and Security teams investigate incidents and take action efficiently.




Team building: Help establish the technical foundations and engineering culture for a new, high-impact function at Phantom.




Qualifications



Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience




8+ years of full-time software engineering experience




Experience designing and operating reliable, data-intensive production systems




Strong product judgment and the ability to balance user experience, financial risk, and operational complexity




Ability to work across frontend, backend, APIs, data pipelines, and third-party integrations




Demonstrated interest in protecting users and building trustworthy financial products




Nice to have: Experience with fraud, risk, identity, KYC, AML, sanctions, payments, fintech, or blockchain systems




English language proficiency




Why Work with Us



First impressions matter: Wallets are responsible for a users first impression with crypto and onboarding new users into crypto. By ensuring that a user has a great first-time experience with crypto, we can help supercharge the growth of the entire ecosystem.




Make crypto easier to navigate: There is no easy way for a user to discover and navigate all that crypto has to offer. Wallets have a unique opportunity to help users not only onboard to crypto but also stay retained by exploring new things to do.




We live in a multi-chain world: We currently support Solana, Ethereum, Polygon and Bitcoin with more networks to come in the new future. We are focused on creating a unified, multi-chain crypto experience for users.




Benefits



Competitive salary and equity




Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision) — 100% covered




Stipend for your ideal remote set-up




Flexible hours and a supportive remote environment




Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)




401(k) retirement plan




Monthly wellness benefit




Weekly meal benefit




Global off-sites




The target base salary for this role will range between $200,000 to $250,000 with the addition of equity and benefits. This is determined by a few factors including your skillset, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews and market factors (such as location) at the point in time of offer.


We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for Full-Stack engineers to develop and maintain both front-end and back-end components of our product suite.

Your general responsibilities will include:

Building and maintaining our products and platform on top of our cutting-edge voice models, which will be used by millions of users.

High degrees of ownership. You will be responsible for shipping end-to-end features across the front and back ends of our stack, as well as helping set the direction of the features and products you're working on.

Collaborating closely with others on the Engineering, Growth and Sales teams to understand, and design solutions for, our customer and internal team’s most important problems and workflows.

We believe in pairing engineers with work that matches their strengths and interests. This means that there is significant flexibility in staffing engineers across the company.

Specific responsibilities might include:

Scoping and building brand new proof of concept products, sometimes directly with partner customers, that could later be scaled to capture entirely new markets.

Improving our existing products to ensure that they’re intuitive, powerful and make innovative use of our research team’s latest break-throughs. This could involve making sweeping UX changes, adding significant functionality, or building integrations with other common consumer/enterprise solutions.

Maintaining and strengthening our internal infrastructure as we scale and grow to ensure that our products remain live, performant and secure.

Working to collect, manage, and process massive-scale datasets to lay the groundwork for the next generation of voice models at the forefront of generative AI.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic software engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions.

We do require:

Expertise in Python

Experience with Web Development using Typescript/React

Familiarity with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions, data structures etc.

Bonus: Test design and security awareness

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

  • Building upgrade prompts where users run into paid features
  • Improving the trial experience, including trials of GitLab Duo

title: Fullstack Engineer (TypeScript), AI Engineering: Duo Client SDK
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Fullstack Engineer on the Duo Client SDK team at GitLab, you'll build the shared foundation for every GitLab Duo client. Today, the logic that powers Duo in editors lives inside the GitLab Language Server. We're extracting it into a true software development kit (SDK): a set of well-versioned TypeScript packages that editor extensions, our web-based Duo Chat on GitLab.com, and eventually external applications can use.

You'll work in TypeScript across frontend and backend systems. You'll design the SDK's Node.js core and public application programming interface (API), and work in the clients that use it. The work rewards care about interfaces, versioning, and backward compatibility as much as features because other engineers will depend on what you build.

You'll have senior and staff engineers alongside you to help with design. You'll own the implementation of scoped packages and ship improvements with minimal guidance while collaborating with the team on larger architectural changes.

Some examples of our projects:

  • The Duo Client SDK, extracting versioned, publishable packages from the GitLab Language Server
  • The GitLab Language Server, rebuilt on top of the SDK as our polyglot surface
  • Duo Chat on the web, as one of the SDK's first consumers

What you'll do

  • Develop secure, well-tested, and performant TypeScript features that solve technical problems of moderate scope and complexity.
  • Ship small features and improvements with minimal guidance, writing tests with every merge request and contributing to code reviews and design discussions.
  • Extract and publish TypeScript packages from the GitLab Language Server, migrating consumers incrementally so no parallel implementation is left to drift.
  • Design durable public APIs with clear interfaces, semantic versioning, changelogs, and deprecation paths for external consumers.
  • Build isomorphic core packages that isolate platform-specific behavior in adapters at the edges.
  • Build and improve SDK client surfaces, including Vue 3 components in Duo Chat on the web, in collaboration with product, design, and engineering teams.
  • Strengthen credential handling across hosts, including bearer tokens, session cookies, and CSRF protection.
  • Optimize bundle size, startup cost, and dependency weight for browser consumers, and support a Tier 2 on-call rotation for urgent engineering issues.

What you'll bring

  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript across frontend and backend systems, including experience building and maintaining Node.js services.
  • Experience with modern build and packaging tools, including monorepos, multi-module builds, ECMAScript modules (ESM), and dependency management.
  • Experience with Vue 3 and the Composition API, or comparable component-based frontend experience and a willingness to learn Vue.
  • Experience designing APIs that other people use, with the ability to explain what you'd do differently.
  • Understanding of the differences between running code in Node.js and in the browser, and how to write code that works in both.
  • A security-minded development approach, including careful credential handling and performance optimization.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely in writing about technical problems, propose iterative solutions, and work effectively in an agile environment.
  • Self-motivation, strong organizational skills, and the judgment to ask for help when needed while thriving in a fully remote organization aligned with GitLab's values.

About the team

The Duo Client SDK team sits in GitLab's AI Clients stage and works closely with teams building GitLab Duo experiences. We collaborate across client surfaces to make thoughtful technical decisions as the platform evolves. We work fully remotely and asynchronously across regions, in the open, following GitLab's values of transparency and open communication.

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

2+ years of professional software engineering

Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

Regular use of an AI coding tool

Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

At least 10 hours a week, starting now

A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer
